title: User Admin Supporting Role Read Permission Consistency

items.action: view organization users on the Users admin page
load assignable roles for role-dependent user creation or role changes
create an organization user when role selection is available
update user fields without requiring a role lookup when the role is unchanged

migration.reason: Existing Core permission codes are reused.

backend.reason: Core user and role endpoint authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No endpoint or payload schema changes are introduced; optional role_id is omitted for unchanged-role updates.

audit.reason: No audit contract changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The Users route intentionally remains governed by identity.users.read; identity.roles.read is only a supporting capability.

notes: The Users admin route remains identity.users.read-only. Assignable-role lookup is attempted only with identity.roles.read, role lookup failure cannot erase the user list, role-dependent creation is fail-closed, and unrelated edits preserve the user's existing role by omitting role_id unless an authorized role selection actually changes it.
